instruction: You are given a composite laminate template `/home/user/Desktop/laminate_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/laminate.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/laminate.inp. - Define `*Orientation, name=Ori-1`, with material direction 1 along the X-axis - Define a 3-ply layup: * Ply 1: thickness `0.5 mm`, angle `0°`, material `Carbon` * Ply 2: thickness `0.5 mm`, angle `45°`, material `Carbon` * Ply 3: thickness `0.5 mm`, angle `-45°`, material `Carbon` - Simply support all four edges (`UZ=0`) - Apply uniform pressure `0.1 MPa` (`*Dload, type=P`) 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `laminate.dat`: - Extract global maximum Mises stress - Extract center-point `UZ` displacement - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, center_uz` [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. For this task, use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.
